name: Sex On The Beach
source:
You play as Sasuke, a young man on a pleasure trip. Your main goal is to visit your friend Kana; however, on the paradise island where you meet her, you will also reunite with your ex-girlfriend and with several other girls who are interested in you in different ways.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060360/Sex_On_The_Beach/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演踏上享乐之旅的青年佐助。你此行的主要目的是探望好友佳奈；然而在你们相聚的这座天堂岛屿上，你不仅会与前女友重逢，还将邂逅另外几位对你抱有不同好感的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060360/Sex_On_The_Beach/]Steam[/url]]
